items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15, every volume (18, 1, 10 µL mix) is within the p20 range, wells never exceed 20 µL, and the simulator and end-state checks passed.
Each well in all three loops gets pick_up_fresh_tip() followed by drop_tip(). The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.

The steps run in the specified order and quantities (18 µL, then 1 µL plus a 3x mix, then 1 µL primer, then seal/thermocycle comments). The extra pause is only a tip-rack replacement and doesn't change the outcome.
The loop aspirates 18 µL from master_mix_reservoir A1 and dispenses it into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells; the pcr_plate end-state check passed.
p20 moves 1 µL from the matching colony_plate well and 1 µL from the matching primer_plate well into each pcr_plate well, giving 20 µL; the end-state checks passed.
protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98 °C 30 s, 30 cycles of 98/60/72 °C at 10/30/30 s, 72 °C 2 min, 4 °C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes all measured checks. It uses the p20 with a fresh tip for every well, and it records the seal and the full thermocycling program. The only addition is a tip-rack-replacement pause, which I judged not to change the outcome.
